I embed with the customer, find where the integration actually breaks, and ship a working system that keeps improving after I leave. Two decades across tech, data, and commercial operations in finance, health, sports, and consumer. Most recently I built ARCS from scratch: an AI-native decision-intelligence platform on Claude with an MCP server and agentic orchestration, running in production.
